observations: Eight retail boxes of Lexical Steam Irons are stacked together.
Brand 'LEXICAL' and model 'LSI-1022' are clearly printed on the boxes in photo 0.
The boxes specify a power rating of '1100W'.
Packaging features a 'FOLDABLE HANDLE' illustration and text.
A '12 months' warranty seal is visible on the front of the boxes.
The items appear to be in a retail or storage environment.

claims.evidence: The text 'FOLDABLE HANDLE' and 'STEAM IRON' are visible on the boxes in photo 0.
Requires physical testing to verify heating speed.
This is a subjective performance claim that cannot be verified through photos.

risks.risk: The iron may be defective or fail to produce steam.
risks.proof: A video showing the iron plugged in, heating up, and emitting steam.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual iron outside of its packaging.

risks.risk: The product may be a counterfeit despite the branding on the box.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's rating plate/sticker on the iron itself.

proof_requests: Photo of the iron outside the box.
Video of the iron powered on and steaming.
Photo of the rating plate on the bottom or side of the iron.
response.reason: The brand and model are clearly identified from the retail packaging. The item can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
